{{Quote|General Kenobi, congratulations on a successful mission with Alpha Squad. Your efforts have disrupted the advance of the droid army from the south.|A clone trooper, to General Kenobi|<ref name="Republic Heroes" />}}
'''Alpha Squad''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] that participated in the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]] under the leadership of [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Alpha Squad defended the Republic's [[AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon/Legends|AV-7 Antivehicle Cannons]] against incoming [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]] forces from the south. Both Kenobi and the squad's efforts disrupted the Separatist advance, providing a successful mission. [[Bravo Squad (Galactic Republic)|Bravo Squad]] was unsuccessful in stopping the Separatists from the east.<ref name="Republic Heroes" />

Pushing through Bravo Squad, the Separatists activated their [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] and slowly increased its diameter to keep it in front of the advancing [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces.<ref name="Republic Heroes" /> Eventually, the generator was destroyed and Republic reinforcements arrived, providing a victory for the Republic.<ref name="TCW film">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>
